support.description:
Availability level of this cape for skin generation.

- public: anyone (with the `capes` grant) may generate with this cape
- owner: only usable if the requesting user has a linked Minecraft account that owns the cape
- none: globally unavailable / hidden, cannot be used by anyone

supported.description: Whether this cape is publicly usable. Deprecated - use `support` instead (equivalent to `support === "public"`).
